title: Thaakath
desc: Basya, a cleaner, was found as an abandoned child and was raised by a driver and a conductor. However, he invites trouble when he falls in love with Bagya, the village head's daughter.

title: Bell Bottom
desc: The son of a police constable and an aspiring detective, Divakara begins to investigate a robbery at the police station. However, this leads him to uncover a complex web of secrets.

title: Damarukam
desc: After a demon born from darkness plans to take over the world, a man decides to take matters into his hands and fight to save his beloved.

title: Hejjaru
desc: A man haunted by a thirty-year-old cold case discovers a young stranger suffering the exact same tragedy, leading him to follow the youth into a rabbit hole.

title: Auto Shankar
desc: Shankar is an autorickshaw driver belonging to a middle-class family who gets into a conflict with Maya, a moneylender. However, tables turn when she loses her property, and they fall in love.

title: Benkipatna
desc: Hanumanthu makes a living by sweeping the streets and selling rat poison. His uneventful life changes when Pavani, the girl he loves, is kidnapped by a local gang leader.
